status: Community research reconstruction; not official source or an exact final-damage specification.

primary.author: カンタータ仮面 (Cantata Kamen)
primary.scope: At attack multiplier R=1: base curve only. Final rounding, random variance and the order of final minimum-damage and multiplier operations are not established by these diagrams.
primary.transcription: For x=E-D and positive T: x>=T => U; 0<=x<T => L+(U-L)*x/T; -T<x<0 => max(1,L*(1+x/T)); x<=-T => 1.
primary.threshold: The diagram assigns the threshold to the enemy instance/encounter variant; same-named enemies can differ in alternate dimensions and score attack.
primary.defense: Normal: (2*VIT+SPR)/3; special: (VIT+2*SPR)/3. The diagram says mainly single-target / mainly area, not a strict targeting rule.

compared.readmeLimit: The author states that the majority of the project code was AI-written. README points to community spreadsheets/data but does not establish an official incoming formula.
compared.discrepancy: For -T<x<0 Roy uses L+(L-1)*x/T, instead of the primary diagram's L*(1+x/T) and a 1 floor. The fixture stores both results; this is not claimed as an equality.
compared.referenceScope: Only skillPower is compared. Roy's damage-rate, accessory reductions and +/-10% output ranges are preserved in the source snapshot but not ported by this pure curve.

independentMeasurement.scope: Original equipment-swap measurements support different VIT/SPR defensive references. The June 15 addendum identifies area Confusion Flash as VIT-dependent, confirming that target count is not a sufficient rule. These old measurements do not validate exact current slopes or final rounding.

acquisitionSnapshotStatus: Full image, article HTML and full upstream source/README acquisition copies are kept outside Git in researchArchive. These hashes were checked when acquired; the offline regression does not re-read or re-validate those archived files.
